input.quote: (i) This Agreement is intended for the sole and exclusive benefit of the Parties hereto, is not intended to confer any rights or benefits on any third party, and only the Parties may enforce such Agreement.
input.rationale: A full read of the Agreement (single section, paragraphs p0000–p0074) and a text search for "insurance" return no insurance covenant of any kind — no commercial general liability, professional liability/E&O, cyber, or workers' compensation coverage, and no certificate delivery mechanic. Kubient is a services/hosting vendor that, per its own warranty at p0035, collects, maintains, manages and stores visitor data (including via the Auction Platform) and holds our Confidential Information under Section 12, so the rule squarely applies and the total absence of coverage sits in walk-away territory rather than at the fallback. Inserted the preferred coverage levels (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request) as a new General Provisions subsection (j) after p0073, the natural miscellaneous location; the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment as a negotiation path.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new General Provisions subsection (j)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as none appears in the Agreement and Kubient collects, stores and manages visitor data on our behalf. Our position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; if that is an issue, we can discuss E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide Customer with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
